articleTitle: Finite Element Simulation of Polymer Melt Flow in Extrusion Molding Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In this study, a non-isothermal non-Newtonian Careau flow model was used to describe the flow of polymer melt, and the Galerkin finite element method was used for spatial dispersion. The flow of polymer melt in the extruder was numerically simulated by this algorithm and the distribution law of polymer melt velocity, viscosity, pressure and temperature in the flow channel was obtained. The influence of inlet pressure on outlet velocity was analysed, which provided a theoretical basis for the correct design model and process formulation.

articleTitle: Research on Network Intrusion Detection Strategy Based on Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In response to the information security issues of wireless sensor network intrusion, this article constructed an evolutionary game benefit improvement matrix based on the actual background of attack and defense conflicts and the basic principles of evolutionary game. The stability analysis of the equilibrium strategy between the two parties is conducted, and the sensitivity of the loss parameters is discussed. Furthermore, the effect on convergence speed is analyzed, and the optimal detection strategy algorithm is proposed. Using MATLAB as the experimental platform, the accuracy and validity of the model are verified, which provides a theoretical reference for information security problems in real society.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Chinese Modular System Promotes the Modernization of Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: North America, Europe, Australia and other regions have used vehicle combinations with two or more trailers for cargo transportation. The implementation results show that vehicle combinations can effectively improve transportation efficiency, improve road capacity, reduce fuel consumption and pollutant emissions, and promote the smooth, efficient, safe and green development of the road freight industry. It is an inherent demand of the modern road freight industry to learn from foreign advanced transportation modes and develop vehicle combinations transportation suitable for Chinese national conditions. The article introduces the situation of China's freight vehicles and infrastructure, explains the significance of carrying out pilot demonstrations of Chinese Modular System (CMS) in China, analyzes the feasibility of pilot demonstrations, and finally gives suggestions for pilot demonstration programs.

articleTitle: Research into Developing a Data Mining-Based Quantitative Trading System for Use with Software and High Performance Computers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This research is dedicated to the design and study of quantitative trading systems based on data mining methods in software and high-performance computing environments. With the continuous accumulation of financial market data and the improvement of computing power, quantitative trading, as a method of trading decision making using mathematical models and algorithms, has received more and more attention from traders and investors. In this study, the basic concepts, methods and techniques of quantitative trading are firstly reviewed to introduce the important role of data mining in quantitative trading. Subsequently, a design framework for a quantitative trading system based on data mining methods is proposed, which combines the key steps of data collection, feature engineering, model construction, and trade execution to improve the real-time performance and efficiency of the trading system.

articleTitle: Feature Analysis and Evaluation of Airline Passenger Satisfaction Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The global airline industry is recovering from the COVID-19 pandemic. Passenger satisfaction is on a downward trend despite rising demand. For the airline industry to prosper during this recovery period, it is crucial to identify the critical variables determining passenger satisfaction. This study utilises a decision tree algorithm for data analysis, mathematical modelling and feature selection to reveal the determinants of passenger satisfaction. The model is further refined and simplified by selecting the most significant features. The study is successful in identifying the most vital elements influencing passenger satisfaction. Notably, online boarding, in-flight internet services and personalised services for different passenger types emerged as key drivers. Knowledge of these factors enables airlines to focus on specific areas of improvement, thereby increasing overall passenger satisfaction. The implications of these findings for airlines are practical as they provide valuable insights for improving service quality and passenger satisfaction. Addressing the factors identified allows airlines to optimise efficiency, strengthen their competitive advantage and ensure long-term success in the post-pandemic recovery phase. Furthermore, airlines can safeguard their brand reputation and foster customer loyalty by understanding customer preferences and enhancing satisfaction.

articleTitle: The Cooperation Mode of Cross-border E-commerce Logistics Supply Chain Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Establishing an efficient supply chain coordination model is of paramount significance, especially when it involves the integration of participants across various domains. In this section, we delve into the contextual factors contributing to the emergence of the blockchain technology in the realm of cross-border e-commerce logistics supply chains. We then offer an analysis of the prevalent challenges within the cross-border e-commerce supply chain and present a collaborative model based on blockchain technology for optimizing cross-border e-commerce logistics supply chain operations.

articleTitle: Analytical Method and Application of Renewable Utilization Cost Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of peak carbon neutrality on time, the construction of wind and solar power generation projects has been rapidly developed, but in operation, due to the insufficient territorial absorption capacity and the limited power received by the grid, there are often waste phenomena such as wind and light abandonment, exposing the problem of high cost of new energy utilization. In this paper, the existing new energy utilization cost is disassembled, graphically classified and quantitatively analyzed, and combined with the functional attributes of the system equipment such as power generation, energy storage, peak load balancing and absorption, the optimization model is established from the perspective of grid side power balance, power balance and peak load balancing, and the criterion expression is given. It is pointed out that the unit investment cost is not the unit kilowatt investment of the energy storage class, but the difference between the unit kilowatt investment of the energy storage class and the adjustable conventional unit. To evaluate the net peak-regulating demand of new energy, we must consider the peak-valley difference of new energy and the trusted capacity of new energy. It provides an analytical evaluation method of utilization cost for the layout, planning and construction of new energy utilization.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of Overspeed Protection Logic for GE Units on Hongliu West Second Line
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: For gas turbine driven units, as a high-speed rotating machinery, the stress and speed of its rotating components are closely related, and its stable operation is related to the safety of the entire unit. Due to the centrifugal force being proportional to the square of the rotational speed, as the rotational speed increases, the stress caused by the centrifugal force will rapidly increase, which may result in potential flying objects or even “flying car” accidents due to high-speed rotation. Therefore, the overspeed protection system has become one of the important protective devices for gas turbines. This article briefly introduces the basic components of the Bentley system and Mark VIe system, and provides a brief introduction to the overspeed protection systems used in both systems. Introduce the optimization plan for the overspeed protection logic of the GE unit in the second line of Hongliu compressor station.

articleTitle: Model Construction of Managers' Influence on Corporate Social Responsibility Behavior Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: CSR (corporate social responsibility) has become an important part of enterprise management, which has a far-reaching impact on enterprise performance and reputation. As the leader of an organization, managers play a key role in formulating and implementing corporate social responsibility strategies. The purpose of this study is to build a model based on big data analysis to explore the influence of managers on corporate social responsibility behavior. The research uses a variety of data sources, including internal data, social media data, shareholder feedback data, etc., to understand how managers' decisions and behaviors are related to corporate social responsibility performance. The results show that there is a significant positive correlation between manager's ability and corporate social responsibility at the level of 0.01, and manager's ability is positively related to corporate social responsibility performance, which is consistent with the main effect test, and the test results of main effect are further verified. There is a positive correlation between managers' ability and corporate social responsibility; When the power of managers is constrained, the degree of corporate social responsibility of high-ability managers is enhanced; When managers' power is not restrained, the degree of fulfilling corporate social responsibility of managers with low ability is weakened.

articleTitle: Process Design of Intermediate Cylinder Parts of Brake Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The hydraulic brake is made of pressure oil as the working medium, and the hydraulic brake has the advantages of small size, light weight and compact structure, so the hydraulic brake components are compact and can be integrated on the bogie in a small volume. In the hydraulic brake device, the intermediate cylinder block is the key part, and the intermediate cylinder block provides braking force to the brake through the disc spring. In this paper, the structure and materials of the intermediate cylinder block parts are analyzed, the process plan of the parts is drawn up, and the processing technology of the parts is designed, which provides a reference for the formulation of the processing technology of the parts.

articleTitle: Research on Security and Privacy Protection of Edge Computing Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the industry's digitalization process, people pay more and more attention to edge security. However, the security issues of edge computing still need to be further explored, such as the vulnerability of edge node data to be destroyed, the lack of protection of private data, and the lack of access control management continue to pose a threat to user privacy. Blockchain has the characteristics of data non-tampering, record traceability, and multi-node consensus. Applying blockchain to the research field of edge computing can provide a trust mechanism for edge computing, establish a complete security guarantee and data anti-counterfeiting storage certificate for edge systems, open up information islands between different edges, and promote multi-level network collaboration of edge computing. This paper focuses on the device access authentication mechanism and blockchain data privacy protection model under the edge computing architecture. The call time and the total execution time of each business module of the smart contract designed by using the Paillicr homomorphic encryption algorithm are stable, and it has good operational performance on the Hyperledger Fabric platform.

articleTitle: CNN-LSTM-Based Smart Field Station Electric Load Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the smart field station, a large number of energy-using devices are deployed, and changes in power loads are complex and uncertain. To grasp the change of power load in time and make an orderly power consumption plan, this paper proposes a CNN-LSTM-based power load forecasting method for smart field stations. First, feature extraction is performed on the raw load data using CNN to capture the temporal features and local correlations of the input data. Then, the extracted feature sequences are input into an LSTM model for modeling the temporal dependence and long-term memory effects of the load data to obtain prediction results. The comparison experiments show that the scheme has good superiority and stability compared with other detection models.

articleTitle: Using Big Data to Conduct Information Analysis of Adaptive Algorithms for Higher Mathematics Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The goal of this work is to improve the resource sharing and management level of higher mathematics teaching courses by proposing a higher mathematics teaching system based on the particle swarm optimisation algorithm. Construct a fusion model that can be used to teach complex maths, utilise the fusion particle swarm's optimisation algorithm to realise self-adaptive scheduling of advanced knowledge auxiliary teaching resource courses, and incorporate the particle swarm's autocorrelation properties. Using fuzzy association combination of features and data analysis, the self-adaptive optimisation of auxiliary teaching resources fusion for mathematics advanced knowledge courses is accomplished.

Author Keywords: assisted teaching system for advanced mathematics

articleTitle: The Study of Cerebral Blood Arteries in Three Dimensions Using an Optimization Technique Based on Relative Position Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: For the three-dimensional reconstruction of CT cerebrovascular medical image registration, an optimization technique based on the relative position data of each vessel contour in the image is recommended. The idea that the centre of gravity of the vascular tissue structure on a succession of slices has continuity is used to find the registration connection between the blood vessel outlines in two adjacent slices. The cerebral vessels' centre of gravity deviates somewhat from their geometric centre because of the relative symmetry of their outline form. The geometric centre therefore replaces the centre of gravity in order to perform the registration of the blood vessel contour, and they” quality” of each contour is assessed based on the area of each contour. This method offers an efficient preoperative simulation for cerebrovascular interventional surgery. Its advantages include global optimization, strong robustness, and more accurate cerebral vascular pictures that may be used for study later on, simulation training, and software import.

articleTitle: India's Journey to be Part of the World's Leading Spacefaring Countries: Chandrayaan-3 Mission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Successfully facing challenges that other countries of the World failed to cross and ultimately resulted in the failure of their Lunar missions of targeting the polar regions has consolidated India's place in successive moon missions as India has achieved this outstanding engineering and astronomical milestone. The Chandrayaan-3 mission is single-handedly driven and managed by Indian scientists to land on the South pole of the moon and study the soil and rock composition, presence of water ice, and amount of hydroxyl ions, and minerals on the Lunar South pole being carried out by the instruments sent with rover Pragyan. The data that will be sent to the earth will open the gates for the various possibilities and opportunities on the moon such as management and fulfilment of the need for water on future lunar missions, useful minerals present there, etc. In Chandrayaan-3, industrial IoT played an inevitable role in the whole of the mission as scientists needed to remotely monitor and control it accordingly through the commands on the basis of what IoT sensors and IoT devices were sending information and pictures regarding the conditions present on the moon.

articleTitle: Study on the Joint Probability and Return Period of Extreme Precipitation in Baoji Area Based on Copula Function
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The Copula function can quantitatively assess the risk of extreme precipitation under different joint return periods. Taking Baoji area as an example, six extreme precipitation indicators were selected, and the preferred edge distribution function was tested by K-S, AIC, BIC and RMSE criteria. The results showed that: the Copula function can be used to perform bivariate fitting. While the Gaussian-Copula function could better fit the joint probability distribution of the extreme precipitation index and the risk assessment of extreme precipitation under different joint return periods of extreme precipitation index in Baoji area. The risk of extreme precipitation events in Taibai and Meixian was higher in high and low scales, respectively. R95P, R99P, R×1day and R×5 day of extreme precipitation index in Meixian had the fastest growth rate, had the smallest growth rate in Taibai, and PRCPTOT in Meixian only showed a significant increase trend. Spatially, the increase area of PRCPTOT, R×1day and R×5day accounted for 65-82% of the total area. Under SSP4.5 and SSP8.5 emission scenarios of CMP6 climate model, the extreme precipitation index will be an increase trend, and have increase significantly after the 2060s. The studies provide a basis for government decision-making, disaster defense planning.

articleTitle: Personalized Intelligent Knowledge Management Design of Electric Power Professional Technology Based on Domain Characteristic Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: An efficiently designed personalized intelligent knowledge management system for power technology can help maintain a cost-effective customer base. This is pivotal in achieving the informatization, automation, and intelligence of power grid services. The research undertaken in this paper aims to introduce domain-specific knowledge maps as a novel data storage element within the realm of personalized intelligent knowledge management for electric power technology. The approach involves recording search logs for missed maps when users search, followed by clustering these logs. This process enables the extraction of high-frequency search queries, which are then presented to the knowledge base management system for review by knowledge base managers and domain experts. Knowledge base managers can select valuable knowledge, refine it, and add it to the knowledge base. Subsequently, they dynamically construct the knowledge map to ensure continuous map updates. By utilizing power science and technology papers as connections, the dispatching entity section and the power equipment entity section of the map can be seamlessly interconnected. This prevents the formation of isolated entity islands in the power knowledge map and enhances the precision of entity connections between maps. The semantic network characteristics of the knowledge map optimize the description of semantic relationships between standards, thus enabling deeper and more fine-grained knowledge management. This forms the bedrock for intelligent applications as an underlying knowledge base.

articleTitle: Target Detection and Tracking Techniques for Vehicles in Real-Time Scenarios Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Vehicle detection and tracking techniques in real-time scenarios based on YOLOv8 are thoroughly investigated in this study. The relatively quick “One-stage” model is used for the vehicle target detection problem., the recently released YOLOv8 algorithm by Ultralytics is adopted., and the dataset UA-DETRAC is used as the input for training and testing on the MistGPU platform. The final model exhibits greater than 90% accuracy and recall after 300 training rounds and a batch size of 64. The total number of training rounds is 300., and the batch-size is 64. The final model exceeds 90% in terms of precision., recall., etc. ., and shows strong stability. For the vehicle target tracking problem., multi-target tracking techniques and real-time tracking are generally used in real-time scenarios.

articleTitle: Assessment and Evaluation Model for Road Transport Safety Production Supervision and Inspection Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: For the work of assessment and evaluation of road transport safety production supervision and inspection Institutions, this paper proposes an assessment and evaluation model for road transport production safety supervision and inspection institutions. By the means of constructing the assessment and evaluation index system and using hierarchical analysis method, the assessment and evaluation content of road transport production safety supervision and inspection institutions is decomposed into assessment and evaluation indexes of multi-level structure, which constitutes an orderly hierarchical structure. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to assess the assessment and evaluation content of road transport production safety supervision and inspection institutions, so as to provide an assessment and evaluation model for the assessment of road transport production safety supervision and inspection institutions.

Author Keywords: assessment and evaluation of road transport safety production supervision and inspection institutions

articleTitle: Scheduling Design and Method Verification in Computer Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: When dealing with large-scale computation, it will inevitably involve the following problems, such as information synchronization, communication coordination, task disposal, task adjustment, parallel and distributed algorithm design in distributed environment, etc. In order to improve the scheduling efficiency in computer control, this paper studies the common job scheduling evaluation system at present. Moreover, this paper uses the average response time, average waiting time and system utilization as evaluation indicators, and introduces the weighted average response time and weighted average waiting time as evaluation indicators. At the same time, this paper analyzes the architecture of forwarding system and the module composition of data forwarding plane, and abstracts some important functional modules as the focus of simulation. In addition, this paper summarizes the function and running process of the multilevel scheduling simulation model, and verifies the effect of the model combined with comparative experiments. Combined with comparative experiments, it can be seen that this method can improve the scheduling process in computer control and effectively enhance the response speed of the system.

articleTitle: Domain Adaptation Applied to Authentication in Underwater Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Underwater communication networks are becoming increasingly complex, and the cross-domain adaptation problem is an important challenge for authentication in hydroacoustic communication networks. In this paper, based on the idea of adversarial training, Domain-Adversarial Training of Neural Networks is utilized for authentication of hydroacoustic communication networks, and by comparing with the traditional CNN training, we confirm that the DANN model is better than the traditional neural network under cross-domain environment. The experimental results show that the DANN-based authentication model for underwater communication networks can achieve more than 85% recognition accuracy with different domains. So, the study in this paper demonstrates the feasibility and reliability of DANN, and provides a new idea for solving the domain adaptation problem of hydroacoustic communication network authentication, which is valuable for enhancing the security, realizing high-quality information sharing and high-efficiency cooperative control of underwater communication network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of College Students' Innovation and Entrepreneurship Experience System Based on Multidimensional Dynamic Innovation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Under the current social background, the design and realization of the college students' innovation and entrepreneurship (IAE) experience system based on the multi-dimensional dynamic innovation model (MDIM) is of great significance. This research aims to design and implement a MDIM-based IAE experience system for college students, so as to provide a platform for simulating the real IAE environment, and cultivate college students' innovative thinking and entrepreneurial ability. Through the design and implementation of the system, participants' performance in IAE was assessed. The experimental results show that the participants showed significant improvement in the multi-dimensional IAE tasks. The score of innovation ability increased from 3.9 before the experiment to 4.2 after the experiment, and the score of entrepreneurial ability increased from 3.8 to 4.0. These results confirm the validity of the multidimensional dynamic innovation model and the positive impact of college students' IAE experience system on their ability development. This study provides an effective IAE training method for college education, and promotes the improvement and development of IAE ability of college students.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification and Analysis of Spam Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the proliferation of Internet use and online communication, the issue of spam, characterized by the inundation of unsolicited or unwanted messages in large numbers, has become an enduring challenge. Spam classification, the automated task of identifying and filtering out spam, has been a subject of extensive research. This paper evaluates the performance of five machine learning models, namely Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and LightGBM, through comprehensive training using confusion matrices and accuracy ratings. The evaluation process is carried out following three main steps. First, the spam dataset is meticulously analyzed and subjected to pre-processing, incorporating feature extraction techniques to adapt its data format. Second, the five machine learning algorithms are applied to construct classification models for data training. Lastly, the strengths, weaknesses, and comparative performance of these algorithms are rigorously assessed. The experimental findings highlight the effectiveness of Naive Bayes and SVM in spam classification. This methodology is instrumental in the development of efficient spam classifiers and enhancing email filtering processes. Moreover, the paper discusses potential future directions in the field aimed at advancing and refining spam detection techniques.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Algorithm in the Design of Human Resource Efficiency Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: As a unique resource for enterprises, human resources play a vital role in the survival and development of companies, holding significant importance for China's economic growth. Given this context, this paper examines human resource efficiency using big data algorithms and introduces an analysis model for human resource efficiency. Through this model, we study the optimal allocation of human resources. Comparative simulation experiments show that the primary discrepancy between the supply and demand of human resources in companies is a structural misalignment that cannot adjust to shifting needs. Small and medium-sized enterprises should establish a democratic system where employees actively participate in management decisions from various perspectives and through diverse channels. By encouraging employees to contribute ideas for company growth and fostering communication, we can harmonize the relationship between management and staff. Balancing the protection of employee interests with production growth is crucial, as it aids in building a unified community spirit.

articleTitle: English Composition Assisted Writing Training Based on Big Data Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the wide application of computer multimedia technology in university English language teaching (EL T)., the automatic evaluation system (AES) of English composition has become the breakthrough point for English teachers to reform ELT means and methods. Because of the openness of the composition itself and the subjectivity of the marking staff in the marking process., it is always difficult to ensure the consistency of the marking standards. This article proposes an automatic assessment algorithm for English composition based on big data text mining, which provides theoretical model support for the development of intelligent auxiliary tools for English composition training. The simulation results show that the accuracy of this algorithm has obvious advantages, reaching more than 93%, compared with the support vector machine (SVM) algorithm and the random forest (RF) algorithm. Therefore, the automatic essay evaluation (AEE) model based on big data text mining is a reasonable and feasible assessment model, which is of great significance for the innovation of AEE system. Using this model to effectively assist manual assessment can truly test students' practical language application ability, assist students' English composition writing training and help students effectively improve their writing ability.

articleTitle: Structure and Material Optimization of Steel Coil Bracket Based on Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: It is very important to design the pallet rack structure and select the material, because the steel coils of iron and steel enterprises should be packaged vertically and placed on pallet racks, and carried by pallet racks during stacking, handling and transportation. In this paper, the three-dimensional model of the bracket is established and the force analysis is carried out. Then the mechanical properties, weight and cost were evaluated comprehensively, and the optimization scheme of the bracket material and structure was obtained. Finally, the finite element method was used to simulate the bracket operation, and the correctness of the optimization scheme was verified. The result shows that the optimized wooden pallet can fully meet the strength and stiffness requirements, and the weight is reduced by 23.6%, and the cost is reduced by 69.8%. This wooden pallet has been widely used in the production site. This paper has certain reference significance for cost reduction, efficiency increase and green energy saving in the logistics industry.

articleTitle: A Road Transport Work Order Claim Discovery Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The various work orders collected by the National Transportation Service Supervision Hotline, such as public complaints and reports, problem consultations, and opinion suggestions, have the characteristics of large data volume, diverse appeal themes, and uneven text length. From the hotline data, it was found that the normalized demands of road transportation mainly rely on manual inspection or simple text segmentation statistics, and the discovery efficiency and recall rate are low. The road transportation normalization problem demand discovery method proposed in this article based on machine learning and natural language processing technology overcomes the shortcomings of traditional manual discovery methods such as low efficiency, low recall, and strong subjectivity. Compared with conventional topic discovery and text clustering processes, the road transportation problem demand discovery method based on deep learning in this article can improve the accuracy of topic discovery.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Commerce Supply Chain Management through IoT-Based Optimization Research
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This study aims to explore methods for optimizing e-commerce supply chain management processes based on Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to cope with the growing e-commerce market and supply chain complexity. The rapid growth of the e-commerce industry and the diversification of consumer demands have driven the importance of supply chain management, while IoT technologies provide new tools and opportunities for supply chain management. This study begins with an analysis of traditional e-commerce supply chain management processes, highlighting the challenges and bottlenecks involved, such as inventory management, order processing, and transportation optimization. The application of data analytics and big data techniques to IoT data to optimize inventory management, forecast demand and improve supply chain efficiency is also explored in the study. Finally, the study summarizes the benefits of optimizing e-commerce supply chain management processes based on IoT technologies, including reduced inventory costs, more efficient order processing, reduced shipping time and improved customer satisfaction. Recommendations for further research and practice are then made to better utilize IoT technologies to address the ever-changing e-commerce market and supply chain challenges. This study provides practitioners and researchers in the e-commerce industry with useful insights on how to optimize supply chain management processes for the evolving business environment.

articleTitle: Research on Translation Strategies of International Publicity Integrating Artificial Intelligence Translation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the stage of globalization, the translation of international publicity, as an important medium of language and culture communication, has aroused widespread concern and discussion in society. In this paper, a machine translation (MT) semantic model based on feature extraction algorithm is proposed, through which the relationship between fuzzy semantics is mapped to better extract the features of sentence content. In this model, a template matching model for automatic calibration of MT is constructed by using differentiated semantic modification method, and a semantic tree for automatic calibration of MT is established by combining with syntax analysis method. The experimental results show that: compared with other algorithms, the error of this algorithm is lower, mean square error (MSE) is about 4.15, mean absolute error (MAE) is about 1.21; At the same time, the accuracy of this algorithm is higher than the other two algorithms, which can reach 95.97%, and it has certain superior performance. The comparative experimental results show that the designed system can get the optimal translation and the translation accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Supply Chain Resilience: A Study on the Core Characteristics and their Drivers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The supply chain is the most basic core component of the manufacturing system, and it is also the most complex and fragile network system. In the complex VUCA environment, it faces great black swan risk. Once the outbreak directly brings heavy or even fatal blow to the manufacturing industry, so the demand for the resilience of the manufacturing supply chain is one of the focuses of the government and all sectors of society, and the hot topic of academic research. Based on the basic functions of the manufacturing supply chain, this paper analyzes the core characteristics of the manufacturing supply chain toughness and the driving factors of its formation, and builds a manufacturing supply chain toughness structure model to provide reference for the development of the manufacturing industry in the practice of chain reinforcement, solid chain, strong chain and extended chain.

articleTitle: Design of College Students' Innovation and Entrepreneurship Management System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to strengthen the application, evaluation, mid-term inspection, final acceptance and fund management of college students' innovation and entrepreneurship training programs, it is necessary to develop a project management system for college students' innovation and entrepreneurship training programs by using modern computer technology. The content of this paper is to develop a management system for college students' innovation and entrepreneurship based on deep learning, including reasonable database design and friendly interface design, which mainly realizes the functions of information release, student registration, information inquiry, project review, project conclusion and system background management. The system is a B/S structure and a Web server. The application included in this system architecture can be divided into three parts, namely, data acquisition, application server and data server. Predictive project process mining can help managers identify abnormal activities that are not in compliance with the project process. BiLSTM is combined with self-attention mechanism by using deep learning technology, and then the event log in the project process is used as input to realize accurate multi-task activity and time prediction. The test results all meet the expectations, indicating that the system is relatively stable and reliable. And it can solve some problems faced by students through a management platform that can meet the daily management functions for all teachers and students, such as project teaming.

articleTitle: A Study on Data Asset Trading and Sharing Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Data asset trading refers to the activities of using data as the trading object, and conducting data buying, selling, sharing, authorization, etc. through data markets or data platforms. The purpose of data asset trading is to realize the value, circulation and capitalization of data, and thus promote the innovative application and social benefit of data. Data asset trading involves multiple participants, such as data providers, data demanders, data intermediaries, data regulators, etc., who have complex relationships and influencing factors, such as trust, price, quality, privacy, security, etc. Neural network is a computational model that simulates the structure and function of human brain neurons. It can use a large amount of data to learn and infer, and thus solve and optimize complex problems. Neural network can effectively deal with nonlinear, high-dimensional, multimodal, dynamic changing data, and has strong generalization and adaptation abilities. Data asset trading based on neural network refers to using neural network to construct and optimize various links in data asset trading, such as data asset representation, evaluation, matching, recommendation, pricing, transaction, evaluation, etc. This paper aims at the problem of facing many indicators for data asset trading risk evaluation. It uses random forest algorithm [1] to reduce noise and optimize the preliminary indicators. It automatically analyzes the preliminary indicators and iterates with feature importance calculation. It selects the indicators that have greater impact on data asset trading risk as the data asset trading risk identification indicators. To address the problem of not fully utilizing the temporal features of data, it introduces temporal memory network to learn the long-term dependency relationship between long sequence data of time steps. It constructs and represents the complex and deeper functions between risk identification evaluation indicators and data asset trading riskiness.

articleTitle: Tow Enterprise-level Rapid Development Platforms for Business System Development Practice
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The massive amount of data distributed on each node of the Internet of Things provides support for the in-depth analysis and data application of big data. After the analysis of this data, a useful model or method can be formed to serve the node users. In the past, node users were often limited by the knowledge and ability of network development technology, and it was impossible to carry out a network application system that met individual business needs, which greatly reduced the application efficiency of node users to these big data. The development and application of the rapid development platform provides a possibility for node users to develop customized business system applications. Compared with the traditional development mode, the rapid platform development mode has the characteristics of low technical requirements for developers, short development cycle, and more targeted business modules. Enterprise-level rapid development tools generally feature low-code or zero-code, greatly reducing the technical requirements for developers. This paper takes Excel Server and CHARISMA, two enterprise-level rapid development tools, as examples, and discusses the implementation methods of two different business systems. Excel Server is a zero-code enterprise-level rapid development platform, which can realize the development and deployment of enterprise-level business systems in a relatively short time and with high efficiency. Excel Server is suitable for enterprise applications that do not require underlying extensions, and even those who do not have network development skills can develop enterprise-level applications after a short period of training. CHARISMA is a low-code fast platform for enterprise-level users with a certain foundation. In addition to the regular rapid development features, CHARISMA also provides low-level scaling and application development, giving developers more extensibility and flexibility.

articleTitle: Sustainable Supply Chain Distribution Model of Fashion Market Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The fashion clothing brand marketing cycle is notably brief, and its supply chain system is comprehensive, significantly reducing the time from clothing design to production. This agility enables swift responses to consumer demands, aligning with the fast-paced consumer market. This paper delves into the intricacies of marketing and supply chain management within the fashion clothing brand sector. It introduces an optimized management model for fashion marketing supply chains, built upon the foundation of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Simulation results demonstrate distinct characteristics among different decision methods. Decision method 1 exhibits notably higher inventory levels, which largely contribute to its increased cost when compared to decision methods 2 and 3. Decision method 2 presents relatively stable inventory levels for IMI (Item-Managed Inventory) and IPI (Item-Produced Inventory), with average inventory levels of 4.56 and 4.86, respectively. In contrast, decision method 3 achieves even lower inventory levels for IMI and IPI, with averages of 1.52 and 1.42, respectively. This slight increase in IMI and IPI inventory under decision method 2 underscores the effectiveness of decision method 3 in maintaining lower inventory levels. The model proposed in this paper embodies sound supply chain management principles and exhibits practicality and operability. To realize swift fund withdrawal, mature enterprises must efficiently manage logistics, information flow, and capital flow within this model.

articleTitle: Research on IoT Big Data Intelligent Supply Chain System Based on 5G Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This project intends to establish a closed-loop supply chain information service system based on 5G communication. The system can meet the needs of real-time docking, optimal allocation of resources, reasonable scheduling of equipment, and fast integration of services. Furthermore, the system can realize the effects of informatization, automation, intelligence and service-oriented management of the closed-loop supply chain. Three key technologies needed to realize the information service system are put forward and analyzed, and finally the three technologies are applied to actual cases to test the feasibility and scientific of the project. In this way, it provides a reference for the development and innovation of closed-loop supply chain and other disciplines.

articleTitle: Construction of Personalized Intelligent Learning Service Platform for Universities Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the process of AI(Artificial Intelligence) technology development, it has brought earth shaking changes to the education industry. By organizing and summarizing the characteristics and content of personalized learning through scientific teaching theories, a user centered push service model for personalized learning content can be developed. This article constructs a personalized intelligent learning service platform for universities based on AI. Through research, it has been shown that when the number of target users in a group cannot reach the set number of K values, they only need to calculate the similarity of their group, thus reducing the computational workload. It can be seen that the efficiency of generating neighbor sets using group user profiles based on the service platform constructed in this article is much higher than ordinary methods. The platform provides learners with open and on-demand education, promotes educational innovation, and explores the information society. Teaching is student-centered, teacher led, and students can access knowledge from resources anytime and anywhere. Realize the deep integration of information technology and education and teaching, ultimately achieving the educational goal of promoting learners' development and enhancing their intelligence.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Cross-Chain Collaborative Traceability of Supply Chains in Heterogeneous Blockchain Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the supply chain, cross-link traceability data sharing and query is an important task. In heterogeneous blockchain scenarios, multi-dimensional cross-chain collaborative traceability can be achieved using a multi-level index structure. The chain of each link has a local index and a global index, which are used to store the traceability data of this link and other links. Through local indexes and global indexes, chains in different links can search and share data, realizing cross-chain traceability of the supply chain. “Xinghuo Chain Network” is a new type of infrastructure built by China Academy of Information and Communications Technology based on licensed public licensed chain technology and distributed identification technology. Taking this platform as an example, this paper studies the method and application of realizing multi-dimensional cross-chain collaborative traceability of supply chain in the heterogeneous blockchain scenario, and starts with the application scenario in the alliance chain to discuss how to solve the traditional supply chain financial risk control problem and realize the digital transformation and upgrading of the whole process of supply chain.

articleTitle: Machining Technology Design and Numerical Control Simulation of Impeller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The impeller is a very important part of the fan. When the wind passes through the impeller, it drives the impeller to rotate, which drives the generator to rotate and converts the wind energy into electrical energy. Impeller processing relative to some simple parts, more complex, parts processing accuracy is high, the processing difficulty is mainly the blade, the blade is easy to deform, the main processing method is the combination of turning and five-axis milling. In this paper, the structure of the impeller is analyzed, the process of the parts is analyzed, the special fixture of the impeller is designed, the numerical control simulation of the impeller is carried out on the simulation software, and the simulation accuracy of the impeller machining UG tool route is analyzed in the simulation software, the results show that the design scheme is reliable.

articleTitle: Analysis of Warehousing Products of Cross-border Electronic Commerce Based on TRIZ Model and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the warehousing efficiency of cross-border electronic, this paper combines TRIZ model and loT technology to analyze the warehousing process of cross-border electronic. From the perspective of the whole supply chain, this paper analyzes the current situation of the supply logistics problems of cross-border electronic commerce companies, analyzes the root causes of the problems by using fishbone diagram method, and puts forward the optimization ways to solve the main root causes, and puts forward suggestions to ensure the implementation. Moreover, this paper analyzes the application mode of TRIZ model and Internet of Things technology in the warehousing of e-commerce, and constructs corresponding models to efficiently solve various invention and creation problems that have appeared or have not appeared. In addition, this paper summarizes the existing rules by analyzing the existing inventions, and generalizes a set of systematic innovative methods and tools including the solution process, and evaluates the logistics mode by using TRIZ's ideal degree analysis method. Finally, through the comparative analysis results, we can see that the warehousing model of the cross-border electronic commerce based on TRIZ model and Internet of Things can effectively improve the warehousing efficiency of cross-border electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Anomaly Time Series Detection and Prediction for Internet of Things (IoT) Based on Redis Visualization and Alert
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the continuous development of computer and internet technology, Internet of Things (IoT) devices have emerged, connecting physical objects with the internet. However, these devices often lack the ability to operate perfectly and automatically or provide real-time notifications and alerts. In light of this issue, I have developed a method based on Redis that enables the detection and prediction of anomalous data, along with the capability to send alert emails to the user. Except. all the data are visualized.

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Execution of Virtual Reality Merchandise Software Utilizing the Artificial Intelligence Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: As a method of immersive interaction, virtual reality (VR) is rapidly permeating a variety of disciplines due to the continuous development of artificial intelligence and deep learning technology. This study seeks to investigate the design and implementation methodologies of AI-based deep learning-based interactive product software for virtual reality. The study first provides an overview of virtual reality technology and deep learning algorithms, and introduces their application prospects in interaction design. Then, the study details the key technology of gesture recognition based on deep learning to enhance the naturalness and immersion of virtual reality interaction. In terms of software design, the study designed a prototype of a virtual reality interaction product that integrates the above techniques, and evaluated its performance and user experience through experiments. The experimental results show that the virtual reality interaction product based on AI deep learning algorithms has achieved significant improvement in terms of interaction effect and user satisfaction. In summary, this study provides useful guidance and reference for further promoting the development of virtual reality interactive products.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Influencing University Performance Based on Feature Selection Optimization Gray Correlation Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: There are redundant indicators in the university evaluation index system, and the university evaluation index data presents the characteristics of high dimensionality and complexity, so the random forest algorithm, which is applicable to the problem of dimensionality reduction of a large number of characteristic indicators, is used to process the university index data; While the entropy weighting method is based on the information contained in the data itself, which can objectively and accurately reflect the characteristics of the data. Meanwhile, the gray correlation analysis can reflect the influence of one thing on another by judging the degree of correlation among factors through the similarity of their time series curves. Therefore, this paper selects the characteristics of the index system based on random forest, retains the more important characteristic indicators, and uses gray correlation analysis to calculate the degree of influence of inputs on outputs, and combines entropy weight method and gray correlation analysis to obtain the comprehensive correlation degree of inputs on outputs, and establish a gray correlation analysis model based on the establishment of a feature selection-based optimization. This paper uses the above model for empirical analysis by taking the index data of some universities as an example, in this example, the model proposed in this paper can reflect the output level and its influencing factors scientifically and reasonably, and has high reference.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Model of Service Quality on Customer's Post-purchase Behavior Intention Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: After the emergence of e-commerce, the research on how to improve the service quality of online shopping focuses on customer loyalty, influencing factors of customer retention and online shopping, a new marketing channel. How to improve the quality of service recovery, prevent or reduce the occurrence of online shopping mistakes, improve customer satisfaction and customer behavior intention, and promote the occurrence of customer purchase behavior from the customer's point of view has become a problem that enterprise managers and scholars think about. Based on big data analysis, this paper studies the customer's post- purchase behavior intention and constructs the influence model of customer's post-purchase behavior intention. The mediating effect of customer satisfaction on the relationship between service recovery quality and customer intention loyalty has also been concerned and verified by scholars in the traditional service situation. Relatively speaking, customer satisfaction, as an emotional response, is highly volatile, while brand preference is relatively stable. However, in the past, most of the research on service recovery focused on traditional service industries. Therefore, the confusion in practice and the lack of theoretical research make the service failure and service recovery under the online shopping environment a valuable research topic.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Fusion Recommendation Algorithm in Optimal Design of Indoor Space Layout
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The era of big data intelligence is coming, and the intelligent recommendation system provides important technical support for the design of interior space layout. In this regard, in order to solve the problem of interior space layout design, an intelligent recommendation system is introduced for optimization. First, the convolution model is used to extract the indoor spatial feature information, and the principal component method is used to reduce the dimensionality of the feature data set. In order to improve the efficiency of spatial layout, a bidirectional long-short-time network is used to build a segmentation and layout model to complete the pre-segmentation of the length of the apartment type. At the same time, a word embedding algorithm is introduced to extract the cross-features of each vector, thereby improving the accuracy of the spatial layout. The researchers found through experiments that when the number of household items is 30, the accuracy of the model is the highest at 0.986. In addition, the researchers also compared the loss performance of the three algorithms and found that the proposed fusion algorithm performed better in terms of data processing. To sum up, the proposed intelligent recommendation system can play an important role in the interior space layout design and provide important data reference for modern interior space layout and design.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Hospital Information Service System Based on Intelligent Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Smart hospital is to apply big data and intelligent technology to hospital medical services to realize intelligent development. The effective use of hospital big data can provide scientific support for hospital management decisions. As the core of health service institutions, hospitals should establish an intelligent management service model through the Internet, not only to provide medical resources support, but also to mobilize social resources to cooperate and work together to provide health management services. Based on the background of building a smart hospital, this paper mainly discusses the application of Internet of Things (IOT) in the information service system of smart hospitals with the aim of improving the medical environment, medical process and optimizing medical experience. The simulation results show that the proposed data acquisition algorithm of IOT sensor layer has better accuracy and stability. Compared with the data acquisition method of hospital information system (HIS) in literature [8], the energy consumption of HIS data acquisition method in this paper is reduced by more than 10%. With the help of IOT, the hospital continuously improves the medical service mode and information management system, simplifies the medical treatment process, improves work efficiency and solves the problem of patients' difficulty in seeking medical treatment.

articleTitle: Construction and Application Research of Government Affairs Cloud Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The government cloud security risk has carried on the comprehensive and profound analysis, with “civil air defense”, “dimension” and “service” is put forward to government cloud infrastructure, storage, network, application take comprehensive security protection measures, from the cloud service, cloud users, third party regulators, law and policy, management is put forward to build government affairs cloud security risk protection system

articleTitle: Research on Stock Price Analysis and Forecasting of Listed Companies Based on Time Series and Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The stock price prediction of listed companies and the analysis of influencing factors are the core topics of this paper. As of the end of June 2022, the number of A-share investors in my country reached 206.2391 million, of which 1.3303 million new investors were added in June 2022, an increase of 10.6% month-on-month. At the same time, stock price forecasting is a key topic of common concern in financial research and quantitative investment. Stock price forecasting is the use of mathematical models to predict the future trend of stock prices. The purpose of this paper is to study the data characteristics of stock prices. This paper constructs different analysis models, and interprets and analyzes the research results from a financial perspective. Explore the time-varying correlation between policies and regulations and BYD's stock price, and use the LSTM model to predict the future stock price, and build the LSTM-ARIMA model to improve the prediction accuracy; The stock price on December 31, 2023, and then aiming at the shortcomings of the LSTM model, construct an LSTM-ARIMA model to improve the forecasting effect. The final trend chart shows that the stock price will fall to a certain extent in the first half of 2023, and will show a steady upward trend in the future.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Processing and Optimization Research of Edge Computing in Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: At present, the manufacturing industry is in the process of intelligent transformation and upgrading. With the rapid expansion of the connection scale of manufacturing terminals, the amount of data generated by network edge devices such as intelligent terminals is also growing rapidly, this puts forward higher requirements for the industrial transmission broadband, the new manufacturing mode has higher requirements for the real-time performance of data processing, and the existing centralized cloud computing processing mode is difficult to solve these problems efficiently. In order to meet the demand of real-time supervision and quality supervision in the field of industrial automation, it is necessary to process and analyze the class of industrial automation material production test data, explore the data processing technology based on edge computing, establish the cloud collaborative data processing method, the factory production inspection data identification, correlation and preliminary analysis, and upgrade the automation equipment. So as to improve the efficiency of industrial Internet data collection and processing, and relieve the operating pressure of industrial Internet automation equipment.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Smart Agriculture Fine Planting System Based on YOLOv3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the application of artificial intelligence and big data technology in the field of agricultural production, modern information technology means such as the Internet of Things, big data and cloud computing are used to deeply integrate with agriculture. An intelligent agricultural fine planting system based on YOLOv3 algorithmis researched and designed, in order to realize theinformation perception and intelligent control in the agricultural production. In order to improve the intelligent management level of agricultural fine planting, it has good feasibility, and has important significance in promoting and serving Chinese agricultural modernization and national economic development.

articleTitle: Research on Natural Environment Protection Based on Blockchain Technology to Facilitate Ecological Balance and Regional Revitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Now the Masai Mara population continues to expand, the wildlife in the reserve is facing serious threats to their survival. The purpose of this report is to establish a management strategy model for local protected areas that balances the mutual interests between local people and wildlife in Kenya.First, Masai Mara divides the protected area into three parts, planting area, protected area, and livestock area, and then conducts correlation analysis on different areas, and concludes that the reduction in the number of wild animals is closely related to the degree of population density, and the area of cultivated land and forest area is highly correlated. So a nonlinear programming model of multiple strategies is established to plan the planting area. Then establish a comprehensive evaluation model based on the entropy weight method, quantify various strategies, and use gray correlation prediction to obtain solutions. This article introduces blockchain related technologies and uses its decentralization, security and transparency to build an architecture that contributes to the actual government protection of wild animals.

articleTitle: Intelligent System Design of Smart Hospital Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology in recent years, hospitals pay more and more attention to intelligence, especially the large domestic third-class hospitals have higher and higher requirements for intelligent construction, and the development of intelligent technology in medical field has become a hot spot in the development of information technology. Through the design of intelligent system, it can meet the information needs of medical business, provide technical support for patients' medical environment and meet the requirements of standardized operation and management of medical buildings. Through the comprehensive introduction of cloud computing technology, the intelligent degree of hospital infrastructure will be improved, the hospital management mode will be fundamentally changed, and the hospital management efficiency will be improved. This paper proposes an intelligent system design solution of smart hospital based on cloud computing, and expounds the overall architecture of the intelligent system solution of smart hospital and the design scheme of each intelligent subsystem.

articleTitle: Design of a Fast Analysis Software for New Satellite Thermal Vacuum Test Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: A set of vacuum thermal test data analysis software has been developed to address the labor-intensive issues in the analysis, control, and evaluation of satellite vacuum thermal test data. Firstly, based on the characteristics of the satellite vacuum thermal test process and data analysis, a system framework was constructed and the overall functions were divided; Then, by sorting out different scenarios of experimental data analysis, temperature data recording and alarm prompt functions were constructed; Finally, based on the characteristics of satellite thermal control and the method of multi satellite parallel testing, a three-dimensional temperature field implementation construction and multi satellite monitoring function were designed.

articleTitle: Construction of Middle School Physics Experiment Platform Based on Internet of Things for Cultivating Students' Creative Thinking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous reform and deepening of the training goal of core literacy talents, the traditional teaching methods are constantly improved in physics experiment teaching in middle schools, and the innovative talent training mode is organically integrated with physics practice, so as to improve the practicality and pertinence of physics discipline. In this article, an assessment model of middle school physics students' innovation ability based on deep learning is proposed. Data are collected through the Internet of Things (IOT), and the collected data are input into the artificial neural network (ANN) model of innovation ability assessment. The performance level of students' innovation ability before and after the cultivation of students' creative thinking is analyzed in terms of instructional content, instructional delivery, instructional materials and instructional assessment. In order to verify the effectiveness of the assessment method, this article carried out a simulation experiment, which proved that it is feasible to apply this method to the assessment of innovation ability of middle school physics students, and it can provide technical support for the construction of middle school physics experiment platform. In the assessment of students' innovative ability, we can find that the cultivation of students' creative thinking is of positive significance to the cultivation of middle school students' innovative ability.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Early Warning Based on Support Vector Machine Algorithm PCA-SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the stock market, there are always some listed companies that cause financial crisis due to bad operation, irregular internal management and external environment change. Due to the lag of financial information and the existence of earnings management and financial fraud in some listed companies, the stakeholders make wrong judgments and lose their interests. Machine learning has the advantage of quickly processing large amounts of data and can efficiently mine valuable information to draw conclusions. Therefore, many scholars apply machine learning to financial early warning. This paper further studies the financial risk early warning model and makes the following contributions: describes the theoretical knowledge of the financial early warning model in detail, and creates the theoretical basis for the subsequent research. To a certain extent, the research of support vector machine on financial risk early warning is in-depth, especially on information technology. The research of risk multi-classification early warning of technical listed companies provides a new way for the same type of research. A PCA-SVM model is proposed, and its performance is enhanced on the basis of the original model. After comparing the PCA-SVM model with other models, it is found that the SVM model has the highest accuracy and the highest stability.

articleTitle: Truck Performance Analysis by Testing and Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Based on the requirements of ECERt37 for N1 trucks, this paper optimized and improved the crash safety performance of a vehicle in sales from two aspects of body structure and occupant restraint system. Firstly, the FE model of full vehicle frontal collision was built, and the correlation analysis was carried out. According to the analysis results, the improvement suggestions of BIW were put forward. Secondly, the occupant restraint system was further optimized based on the improved BIW to reduce the chest deflection, femur force and the upward movement of the steering column. Finally, the above improvement proposals were engineered and reflected in the proto vehicle, and the vehicle assessment test was organized. The results showed that all points meet the regulatory requirements, thus verifying the effectiveness of the optimization proposals.

articleTitle: Construction of “1+X” Certificate System Practice Teaching System for University Financial Management Major Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Essentially, the “1+X” certificate system represents a fusion of traditional academic education and national vocational standards. It serves as a novel framework that incorporates enterprise job requirements into university talent development, constituting a significant departure from conventional vocational education paradigms. The recent surge in university enrollment and the influx of financial management graduates into the job market have led to diversified career orientations among financial management professionals. The challenge lies in establishing a practical teaching system tailored to the “1+X” certificate system, harmonizing academic education with national professional standards, and nurturing candidates well-suited for enterprise roles. This has emerged as a pivotal concern in the educational reform within financial management programs operating under the “1+X” certificate system. This paper leverages big data analysis to construct a practical teaching framework for financial management programs within universities, under the “1+X” certificate system. The goal is to foster innovative talent development approaches, enhance the quality of education, elevate teaching standards, and improve graduates' employability.

articleTitle: Delay Measurement Method and System of Virtual Power Plant Communication Network Supporting Distributed Resource Aggregation Access
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Different types of distributed “source load” resources can participate in power grid regulation in different time scales, corresponding to the service response time of milliseconds, seconds, minutes and hours. Distributed “source load storage” resources such as distributed power supply, industrial load, commercial buildings, energy storage participation in new energy consumption of the grid, peak cutting and valley filling, frequency modulation, voltage regulation and interruptible load control need to respond quickly and regulate accurately, while the dispatching system and virtual power plant dispatch command communication need to pass through the production control region, the management information region, the Internet region and the border protection equipment. The delay of dispatching communication network is difficult to control on demand, the multi-security protection means of mass terminals is lacking, and the user is difficult to accurately control and coordinate output. As a result, the virtual power plant's aggregated distributed resources are difficult to efficiently and real-time participate in the accurate regulation and control of the power grid. The communication network delay measurement scheme is designed, and the distributed measurement tool of network delay is developed to realize the perceptable state of the aggregated regulation and control network. It provides effective support for distributed “source load” resources to participate in accurate regulation and collaborative output of the power grid, helps the effective aggregation and deployment of large-scale distributed flexible resources, and solves the problem of insufficient flexibility adjustment capacity on the load side of the power system.

articleTitle: Design of Online Management System for University PE Courses Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of teaching information construction in universities, the instructional management of physical education (PE) courses has produced a large quantity of teaching information resources. There may be tens of thousands of student data in the university database, and each student's academic performance, attendance rate, course selection and graduation destination need to be recorded and tracked. If these data are not fully utilized and only stored in the database, it will cause a waste of resources. Driven by big data, this paper uses big data to collect, analyze and apply the information of university sports work, and constructs the overall integration scheme of university sports resource information big data cloud management platform to improve the decision-making ability and intelligent level of online management system of university sports courses. There are many kinds of instructional management data involved in the actual education work in universities, so it is need to carry out data analysis for students, teachers, schools and other management work, so as to ensure the rationality of the final decision. Through the online management system, sports students can choose their interested courses more conveniently and avoid the confusion and inconvenience in the traditional course selection method.
