At the same time, the system can recommend suitable courses for each PE student according to his personal situation and preference, so as to improve the pertinence and satisfaction of course selection.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Airline Passenger Satisfaction Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: As competition intensifies, airlines must identify the key factors affecting passenger satisfaction and take appropriate measures to improve their services. To this end, this study analyses airline satisfaction and proposes strategies to improve the passenger experience in the airline industry. The study employs a data-driven approach and machine learning algorithms to analyse comprehensive data including factors such as flight distance, age, delays, in-flight service, ease of online check-in and customer demographics. Specifically, the study uses Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to identify potential patterns and relationships, and then implements the XGBoost algorithm to predict passenger satisfaction based on these factors. In addition, the Bagging algorithm is used to improve the predictive performance of the model. Experimental results on the study dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. The study identifies important factors that contribute to passenger satisfaction, such as in-flight WiFi service, online check-in and type of travel. As well as the closeness of the different factors to passenger satisfaction. These findings provide valuable insights for airlines to optimise their services and allocate resources effectively, ultimately improving customer retention and business growth. By implementing the recommended strategies, airlines can improve service quality, foster customer loyalty and maintain a competitive edge in the dynamic airline industry.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Identification System for Concrete Bridge Cracks by Integrating Machine Learning and Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the increasing use time and frequency of bridges, they will inevitably be subjected to a large number of traffic vehicles and various human damage. In addition, the severe erosion of the natural environment will cause different situations and degrees of damage to the surface of the beam. According to relevant data, cracks are the main factor causing damage to concrete bridges. Therefore, this paper combines machine learning and NN (Neural Network) model to build an intelligent identification system for concrete bridge cracks. Through the system, we can clearly see the recognition of the model on the bridge crack picture. The numerical representation on the diagonal of the Confusion matrix identifies the correct type, and the numerical representation not on the diagonal represents the wrong type. And the research results show that the classification accuracy of this algorithm for the verification set is high, close to the training set, and the Loss function is close to the Loss function of the training set on the basis of the overall fluctuation, so there is no over fitting phenomenon, the uncomfortable training results are good, and the training time is very similar. The algorithm proposed in this paper can accurately identify concrete surface crack images in a short period of time, indicating that the algorithm can be used for crack localization.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Service Chain Construction for Networked Manufacturing Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to solve problems in cross-enterprise resource service chain construction for net worked manufacturing, a mathematical model for constructing net worked manufacturing resource service chain were proposed. This model was designed to distinctly set time, cost and time-cost integration as its target functions. Then, an improved ant colony algorithm for solving the model was also designed. The improved algorithm could enhance convergence speed and global search capability by self-adaptive adjustment information residual degrees and inspiration factors for time-changing. Through a simulation ex ample, according to the mathematical models with the improved ant colony algorithm, the net worked manufacturing resource service chain construction based on time, cost and time cost integration were realized.

articleTitle: A Recommendation Algorithm Based on Enthusiasm Function Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In most modern e-commerce application scenarios, users' preferences for items change over time. Traditional recommendation algorithms can only construct recommendation models based on users' historical behavior or the current attributes of items, often ignoring the phenomenon that some behaviors of users have delayed correlation, thus affecting the final recommendation effect. This paper investigates the time relationship between the characteristics of consumer goods and consumer behavior by introducing the concept of an enthusiastic degree. Then a recommendation algorithm based on enthusiastic degree function theory is designed, which can predict the time-varying curve of the user's preference for item features and accurately calculate the current time point or even any future time point's enthusiasm for items, thus greatly improving the recommendation quality. Then experiments are carried out in the internal environments of enterprises, and the results show that the proposed recommendation algorithm has better optimization results than the traditional collaborative recommendation algorithm for recommending commodities with time-varying demand. Finally, the future research directions of the project have been outlined.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Things Image Compression Method Based on Convolutional Self Coding Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Objective In order to solve the problem that the cloud platform occupies too much data storage space of the Internet of Things in the fields of intelligent manufacturing, intelligent medical treatment and intelligent automobile, and the amount of image data is too large, this paper proposes an Internet of Things image compression method based on convolutional self-coding fusion, and researches the compression method of the collected Internet of Things images. Method Firstly, the collected Internet of things images were grayed to obtain grayscale images. Secondly, the improved convolutional autoencoder (GCNN) model was used to encode, binarize and decode the original color image. Finally, the image decoded by the autoencoder and the gray image were fused and enhanced by the DHSV fusion reconstruction method. Result The proposed method uses the BSDS500 dataset, in which the training set consists of 200 images, the test set consists of 200 images, and the validation set consists of 100 images. The network structure was built according to the way in Section 2.2, the learning rate was set to 0.01 and 0.1 respectively, and the training was performed 100 times with 10 iterations per epoch. Finally, Set8(8 images) is used for testing. The color image is used to evaluate the reconstruction results in visual effect, and the Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) are used to evaluate the reconstruction results. The experimental results show that the compression ratio can reach 2.28, and the compressed space is reduced by nearly 1/2. At the same time, the fusion reconstruction image can reduce the distortion, and maintain a good level of clarity, contrast and information richness. Conclusion The network model and fusion reconstruction method proposed in this paper can quickly extract image features while reducing network parameters, and can fuse the high-resolution information of grayscale images to achieve good reconstruction results, which basically meets the requirements of cloud transmission and storage in the Internet of things scene, and can provide reference for later research.

articleTitle: The Ensemble Learners: Machine Learning Classification of Diabetic Patient Readmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Diabetes is a major health problem that affects a large number of people worldwide. We proposed an effective and reliable method to diagnose diabetic readmission in this research based on machine learning models. The model was developed on tree-based ensemble classification algorithms, such as Decision Tree, Extreme Gradient Boost, Ada Boost, and CatBoost. In addition, to increase accuracy, we stacked the models with Stack Classifier using Catboost classifier as the final estimator. We carried out the experiments on the diabetic readmission dataset obtained from the VCI machine learning repository. We used the Grid Search technique to learn the best practices for model evaluation and hyperparameter tuning. The performances of all six algorithms are measured using different metrics such as AUC, Accuracy, and Recall. AUC measures a classifier's ability to distinguish between classes. CatBoost Classifier outperforms other algorithms in terms of AUC, Recall, and Accuracy, with 68 percent, 58.7 percent, and 63.2 percent, respectively. These findings are validated using ROC (Receiver Operating Characteristic) curves correctly and systematically.

articleTitle: Research on Empowering Agricultural Products Supply Chain with Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Digital technology is playing an increasingly important role in economic and social development. Digital technology helps to explore the value of data in the supply chain, improve the efficiency and transparency of supply chain operations. Digital technology has significant value in improving the efficiency of agricultural products supply chain. The paper start from the analysis of the path for digital technology enabling agricultural products supply chain, then exploring the internal mechanism of digital technology promoting the efficiency improvement of agricultural products supply chain operation. The research results have important reference significance for solving a series of problems in the traditional agricultural products supply chain, such as information asymmetry, inconvenient communication, and production and sales disruption.

articleTitle: Credible Sharing of Smart Medical Data Based on Block Chains
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous development of smart medicine, the applications of block chains have become quite potential in the medical field, promoting the reforms of the medical system and the safe sharing of medical data. However, there are still some problems such as data silos, malicious nodes, low efficiency, and so on. Considering these problems, this paper proposes a medical data sharing model based on credit calculation. Firstly, the shared data is stored by combining private chains and consortium chains, covering all the elements about the chains. Secondly, the improvements of the traditional PBFT consensus algorithm enable the leader nodes and consensus nodes to be selected based on the calculations of the credit value of nodes. In this algorithm, the malicious nodes will get higher credit penalties, thus reducing the bad behavior of the nodes. According to simulation experiments and analysis, the average consensus delay of the improved algorithm RPBFT has got decreased by 25%, and the throughput has got increased by 25%.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Blockchain Expansion Scheme Based on Xinghuo Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous development of blockchain technology, people's performance requirements for blockchain systems are also constantly improving. For distributed chain networks, the increase in the number of nodes and network size will have a negative impact on system performance. However, traditional solutions generally improve the performance of the blockchain system by increasing the number of nodes or through expansion. However, these two methods have certain limitations. On the one hand, because the current chain network mainly uses public chain technology, as the number of users increases, the system throughput is difficult to meet the actual application requirements; on the other hand, most of the existing chain network expansion plans are upgraded and expanded based on the main network, and its security is difficult to guarantee. In this context, a distributed blockchain expansion scheme based on Xinghuo chain network is proPOSed, and its security analysis and performance testing are carried out, in order to provide important technical references for technicians in related industries.

articleTitle: Multi-agent System Coordination and Optimization on the Green Ecological Model and Theory of Supply Chain for Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The Supply Chain Finance Ecosystem Model is different from the traditional supply chain construction concept that starts with enterprises. It emphasizes focusing on industries and cities, integrating regional markets and industry supply interests at all levels. It incorporates green environmental factors, excess capacity warning, and withdrawal concepts into the design of the industrial supply chain model. In this study, it designed the theory of energy efficiency in the industrial green operation network and the Online-to-Offline (O2O) system model, proposed the flexible coverage and control theory of the industrial green operation network, the theory of priority transmission of excess capacity, and elastic access methods. The studies can be used as a reference for the design of platform algorithms.

Author Keywords: Green finance operation in the industrial supply chain

articleTitle: Research on Embedded Primary School Online Teaching System Based on Mobile Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the wide application of embedded system in today's society, many students and technicians have joined the learning army of embedded system, and domestic universities have also carried out corresponding embedded system teaching courses. How to better carry out the “teaching” and “learning” of embedded system courses, and design experimental teaching platforms and supporting experimental projects that meet different majors to improve students' comprehensive ability, especially practical operation ability, is an urgent problem to be solved in embedded teaching. Based on the analysis of the significant impact of the Internet of Things on embedded system teaching, the teaching ideas and methods of the “Embedded Systems” course have been adjusted according to the characteristics of embedded systems. Relevant knowledge points closely related to the application of the Internet of Things have been expanded from distributed control, energy-saving design strategies, software engineering thinking, and other aspects. At the same time, the teaching methods have been reformed, To meet the demand for embedded system talents in the field of the Internet of Things. Through this platform, students can conduct basic experiments on the Internet of Things, complete professional learning of the course system, and conduct practical training and development of small projects; You can also improve from specific basic knowledge points to comprehensive applications by understanding and learning the overall architecture of IoT application engineering through this platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Indicator System for Constructing a Demonstration City for Digital Transformation of Manufacturing Industry in Dongguan, China
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Dongguan City, located in the south-central part of Guangdong Province, is vigorously promoting the digital transformation of manufacturing industry. Its growing scale of manufacturing, optimized industrial structure, and superior geographical location make it a “strategic node city” in the Greater Bay Area. Dongguan City has a solid foundation for constructing a demonstration city for integration of digital technology in manufacturing and has already begun to show significant progress towards this goal. This paper aims to establish an indicator system for constructing a demonstration city for digital transformation of manufacturing industry in Dongguan. The goal is to provide a sustainable development model that can be used as a reference for integration of digital technology in manufacturing in China. Firstly, we establish a hierarchical structure based on different perspectives from Dongguan Municipal Government, manufacturing enterprises and digital enterprises regarding digital transformation. Then, Fuzzy hierarchical analysis (FAHP) is applied to establish an index system for constructing a demonstration city for digital transformation of manufacturing industry in Dongguan. Finally, proposals are offered based on data analysis to guide the construction of this demonstration city.

articleTitle: Construction of Real Mesostructure Model and Numerical Analysis of Uniaxial Compression for Fiber Reinforced Permeable Concrete
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In this paper, fiber reinforced permeable concrete (FRPC) is considered to consist of aggregate, mortar (containing polyacrylonitrile fibers inside), interface transition zone (ITZ) and pores from mesoscopic perspective. Trainable Weka Segmentation (TWS) segmentation algorithm and morphological processing were applied on Computer Tomography (CT) images to extract the components of FRPC to establish a 3D real mesostructure model with realistic spatial structure. The 3D model was used to carry out qualitative numerical simulation of uniaxial compression process of FRPC specimen. Stress, displacement, macroscopic and mesoscopic cracks of the model were analyzed to reveal the fracture process of FRPC. The results showed that the fracture of the model is mainly caused by stress concentration and large deformation at local weak positions. The macroscopic fracturing process of the model consists of three stages: (i) crack initiation period, (ii) slow development period, (iii) rapid propagation period model fracture period. The fracturing process in mesoscopic componnets can be concluded as a progressive failure that consists of three stages: (i) pores and ITZ cracking period, (ii) cement mortar cracking period, (iii) aggregates fracture and structural failure period. The accuracy and reliability of the numerical model construction method was verified by comparing the crack distribution pattern of the model and the destruction characteristics of the specimen in physical uniaxial compression experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Letter of Credit Platform Based on Blockchains
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Letter of credit is widely used in international trade. However, traditional letter of credit is risky because of low efficiency, high possibility of being cheated and high costs. The block chains technology, with its features including being decentralized, unable to be tampered with, and transparent in information, has developed the letters of credit platform. Based on three principles, referring to security, convenience, and intelligence respectively, this paper designs a letter of credit platform based on blockchains aiming at realizing efficient, safe and low-cost cross-border transaction business of blockchains letter of credit. This platform can also be optimized and improved with gradually developed technologies blockchains, in order to further promote the convenience and intelligence of business processes. Keywords-blockchains, letter of credit, international trade, smart contracts.

articleTitle: A novel high-through cell micronucleus detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In response to the challenges associated with cell micronucleus image recognition, namely small target sizes, high class similarity, and limited sample data, A novel cell micronucleus detection algorithm named YOLOv5-ECA is proposed based on YOLOv5. The proposed algorithm gets hyper-accurate micronucleus identification through a series of improvements. To begin with, the anchor frame size is recalibrated based on a meticulously constructed dataset. This process serves to expedite convergence speed while bolstering accuracy. Subsequently, in C3 module, a coordinate attention (CA) is introduced, which enlarging the receptive field and enabling the model to allocate greater focus to crucial elements within processed images. Ultimately, a superficial detection layer is incorporated, thereby enhancing the precision of cell micronucleus identification through multi-scale detection. Comparative analysis with the original YOLOv5 which demonstrates a 2% increase in average precision, accuracy, and a 1.3% enhancement in recall for the YOLOv5-ECA algorithm based on experimental results.

articleTitle: The Influence of Internet on the Performance of Rural Family Entrepreneurship—Data Analysis Based on CFPS2020
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Rural family entrepreneurship not only provides new labor resources for the development of industrial chain in China, but also has an effective positive impact on the upgrading of value chain. Based on the data of China family follow-up survey in 2020, this paper makes an empirical study on the influence of Internet on rural family entrepreneurship. The results show that the entrepreneurial income of families using the Internet is about 15% higher than that of families not using the Internet. There is a positive relationship between online time and family entrepreneurial income. If the average online time is increased by one minute per week, the average family entrepreneurial income will increase by 20 yuan. Through the heterogeneity test of age and years of education, it can be concluded that the middle-aged and elderly people are more influenced by the Internet in terms of entrepreneurial performance, and the Internet has a more significant positive impact on the entrepreneurial performance of families with higher years of education. This paper proposes to popularize the use of the Internet in rural areas, strengthen online education and training, provide a new source of labor for industrial development and supply chain improvement, and continue to promote the upgrading and modernization of China's industrial structure.

articleTitle: Analysis of Archive Management Innovation Mode in the Information Age Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the world entering the information age, the amount of data generated daily has reached unprecedented levels. In this scenario, traditional methods of records management face challenges in dealing with the vast amount of information being generated. This topic can greatly promote the development of supply chain and the Internet of Things to promote strategic innovation. This study explores innovative strategies for records management in the era of big data, utilizing big data technologies to improve efficiency, accessibility, and preservation. Furthermore, this work aims to investigate an analytical approach for an innovative records management model based on neural networks. By harnessing the powerful capabilities of neural networks in processing and analyzing large amounts of data, this research proposes a new neural network approach to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and security of archiving practices. Specifically, the designed neural network in this paper combines an improved artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) with a backpropagation neural network (BPNN). Through experimentation and case studies, the feasibility and effectiveness of the model are validated. The results demonstrate that integrating neural networks into records management can significantly optimize traditional methods and drive the digital transformation of records management in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Construction of Schisandra Chinensis Cloud Medicine Database Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Schisandra chinensis cloud medicinal database is established for achieving digitalization of Schisandra chinensis supply and demand status, intelligent docking of Schisandra chinensis supply and demand, and enhance preventive nature of Schisandra chinensis preparation and timely supplementation. Firstly, basic framwork of Schisandra chinensis cloud medicinal database is designed, and function modules of database are established. Schisandra chinensis cloud medicinal database based on big data technology is designed. Standard specification system and safety guarantee system are confirmed, and application layer, data collection and processing layer, and perception layer and network layer are designed. And big data mining algorithm is established based on Gaussian clustering algorithm, and simulation analysis is carried out for data collection of Schisandra chinensis cloud medicinal database, in addition, relationship between Schisandra chinensis and other medicines is obtained. results show that proposed Schisandra chinensis cloud medicinal database can effectively improve Schisandra chinensis big data management quality.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Decentralized Recommend System Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: As a shared, tamper-evident ledger, block chain is decentralized, open and transparent, and the data is difficult to be tampered with. This paper first summarizes the technology and characteristics of block chain and the current research status of block chain, and systematically analyzes the status and challenges of centralized recommendation system, showing that the characteristics of block chain are of great significance to solve the data security and privacy protection problems of recommendation system. This paper then gives the design and implementation of a decentralized recommendation system platform mainly supported by block chain technology, and supervises the decentralized recommendation system from two main roles: government and users.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Wolf Pack Algorithm based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The wolf pack algorithm (WPA) is a burgenoning swarm intelligence algorithm that simulates the survival behavior of wolves. However, WPA performs a large number of repeated searches in certain areas, resulting in a low efficiency when solving complex function optimization problems. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of WPA, an improved adaptive wolf pack algorithm based on clustering (IA WP AC) is proposed. The core idea of the algorithm is to balance the global search ability and local search ability of the wolves by adjusting the adaptive step size. At the same time, it uses the powerful data classification function of the clustering algorithm to dynamically adjust the number of wolves to make the hunting area more reasonable. Firstly, the mobile step is adaptively changed in three intelligent behaviors: scouting behavior, summoning behavior and beleaguering behavior. Then, based on K-means and nearest neighbor clustering algorithms, the number of wolves is dynamically adjusted to achieve the purpose accelerating the convergence speed and improving the search efficiency. The results show IA WPAC is statistically and considerably better than WPA in solution quality, solution efficiency and solution stability.

articleTitle: Automatic Detecting System of Ship Water Gauge Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Ship water gauge detection is a critical aspect of ship operations and an indispensable component of intelligent port systems. To address the challenges arising from various complex and dynamic factors, this study proposes an algorithm based on YOLOv5 and DeepLabv3+. The algorithm operates in two stages: Firstly, YOLOv5 is employed for ship hull character recognition and introduces a character bounding box correction mechanism, enabling precise character identification and accurate localization. Secondly, leveraging the mmsegmentation framework with DeepLabv3+, the algorithm efficiently segments the water region from the ship body. Concurrently, Canny edge detection is utilized to delineate the waterline. Moreover, a novel algorithm for reading inclined characters is designed to integrate the outputs of object detection and semantic segmentation, thereby facilitating automatic ship water gauge detection. Experimental results demonstrate that the DeepLabV3+-based waterline recognition significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of MIoU (Mean Intersection over Union) and mAcc (Mean Accuracy), achieving an improvement of 2%-3%. Additionally, the algorithm's error rate in comparison to manual recognition remains within the ±5‰ range. These findings affirm the algorithm's efficacy in practical ship water gauge detection scenarios.
